title: The `maxWallet` variable can be bypassed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `maxWallet` variable helps determine the maximum number of `ERC` tokens a user can purchase. In the `ERC314Implementation::buy()` function, it is validated that the user does not exceed `maxWallet`.  ```solidity File: EvFactoryProxyOptFee.sol 443:     function buy(uint256 amountOutMin) public payable { ... ... 461:         if (_opt.maxWalletEnable) { 462:             require( 463:                 tokenAmount + _balances[msg.sender] <= maxWallet, 464:                 "Max wallet exceeded" 465:             ); 466:         }
